label: A necessary concrete power-holder, by Aristotelian modality and Pruss's possibility
description: Test 5's route to a necessary concrete being with Pruss's own premise, replacing the global variant's Euclidean premise. Not a transcription: no premise mentions a necessary being. Establishes no premise. Each non-logical premise is needed and the conclusion holds on a non-Euclidean frame (controls). It uses neither PGP nor C2; its P1-prime is power-grounded modality applied to the joint absence of the actual contingents, so it is not independent of the C2 crux's general theory.
